item.title: Tipping the frontier of climate and nature investment
item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 20 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00862-3

The world is not short of capital, yet investment in climate change mitigation and adaptation, biodiversity conservation, and ecosystem restoration remains well below required levels. A key constraint lies in how investors assess complex investment environments. Rethinking their assessment frameworks could thus help tip finance towards climate and nature goals.

item.title: Achieving transformative recovery following natural disasters
item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 20 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00863-2

Natural disasters create pressure to rebuild quickly, but rushing to reinstate the status quo can restore or amplify the very exposures and inequities that contributed to losses. Recovery systems must aim to reduce future risk, centre equity, and integrate physical, social, economic, and environmental resilience across decades rather than funding cycles.
